note: grdm-dev/elasticsearch2 (ADR-07): Elasticsearch 2.4.6 built natively in installer/images/elasticsearch2 on Temurin 8, running as uid 1000 (the hardening default) with a read-only root: logs on tmpfs, data on the named volume elasticsearch_data, handed to uid 1000 first by the one-shot elasticsearch_data_init (a bind directory under runtime/volumes/ belongs to the host user, or to uid 101 after PR #33; PR #34 review r1 R1-01). Replaces the emulated elasticsearch:2 image that needed 38 minutes to start on Apple Silicon (real install run 19) and its owner-init one-shot.
